expectedIssues: Promo banner text is unreadable, white text on a pale mint background
reportedIssues: In the '3 free deliveries for you' promo banner, the white headline and the white subtext ('Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') are placed on a very light mint-green background. The contrast ratio is far below WCAG minimums, so the offer text and promo code are effectively illegible.

The 'Green Bowl Poké' thumbnail in 'Fastest near you' renders as a few flat red/green blobs on a plate, looking like a low-fidelity or placeholder asset compared with the more finished burger and ramen illustrations used for the other restaurants.

Card metadata is inconsistent between sections: 'Fastest near you' cards show only a delivery fee (no rating or cuisine), while 'Popular right now' cards show rating, time, fee and cuisine. This makes the faster-options row look like it is missing data.

expected.reasoning: Reported issue 0 describes the same white promo text being illegible against a pale mint background.
